title: Synchrony playbook and matrix for all-hands onboard
content:
Purpose:
This doc is a short, actionable playbook to align the all-hands narrative with the Q2 OKR framing and to capture the decision matrix for exec asks. Working draft intended for Product Ops + Exec review.

Audience:
- Execs (founders + SLT) for the narrative and asks
- People leads and comms for framing and Q&A prep
- Eng leads for readiness and demo slots

High-level objective:
Deliver a 45-60 minute all-hands that:
  - Leaves org with 3 clear priorities for the quarter (customer success, reliability, capacity scale)
  - Surface 2 measurable OKRs we expect org-level focus on for the next 90 days
  - Collects top-10 engineering risks and mitigation owners

Key narrative (one-liner):
"From model access to predictable serving: our next quarter is about scaling inference reliability and lowering unit cost at the edge of production."

Draft agenda (45-60m):
  1) Opening (5m) — CEO 1-liner + thermometer (top-line metrics)
  2) Customer spotlight (7m) — CS demo + one customer ask (pre-recorded clip optional)
  3) What we shipped / progress vs last quarter (8m) — short bullets, 2 demos max
  4) Q2 priorities & OKRs (12m) — Product Ops + PMs: present target metrics and why they matter
  5) Reliability & capacity plan (8m) — SRE + Dedicated team: sprint commitments and playbook for surge
  6) Ask slate & how you can help (5m) — specific actions, grooming, recruiting asks
  7) Lightning Q&A + close (5-10m)

Draft OKRs (candidate — need exec signoff):
  Objective A: "Reduce observed tail latency and production regressions"
    - KR1: 99th-percentile token latency across hosted API <= 250ms for 50-token gen on verified models (baseline: 380ms)
    - KR2: Reduce production quality regression alerts by 60% (tracked by eval suite + infra alerts)

  Objective B: "Improve inference unit economics for standard generation workloads"
    - KR1: Average cost-per-1k-token across hosted fleet down 18% (baseline month rolling avg)
    - KR2: 40% of production traffic served from cached/prefetch layer or quantized variants where quality delta < 3%

OKR notes / tradeoffs:
  - These KRs tie to release cadence (model onboarding + quantization experiments). Engineering to provide throughput runbook by Feb 25.
  - Measurement owner: Neal (observability infra), Support: Product analytics for cost metrics.

Decision matrix for exec asks (quick):
  - Ask: Temporary hiring freeze exceptions for SRE surge hires
    - Impact: High on uptime
    - Cost: Medium
    - Exec owner: COO
  - Ask: Increase burst budget for Dedicated Q2 beta customers
    - Impact: Medium
    - Cost: Variable (usage-driven)
    - Exec owner: Head of Sales
  - Ask: Expand two model-compatibility rollouts to reduce fallbacks
    - Impact: High on latency and customer experience
    - Exec owner: Head of Serving Runtime

Open risks (top-10, raw notes):
  - GPU spot market volatility during peak-months — mitigation: pre-book reserved surge nodes (infra plan draft attached).
  - Eval regressions post-quantization — mitigation: gated rollout + canary eval on production prompts.
  - Console metric telemetry gaps for per-route cost — mitigation: short spike project to surface token-level attribution (2 weeks).
  - Demo fragility — prepare recorded fallback for live demos.

Comms plan / timeline (compressed):
  - Feb 16: Finalize narrative + slides (owners signoff)
  - Feb 18: Rehearsal with execs (30m) — record demos
  - Feb 20: Pre-comm to managers + TLs (one-pager + slack thread)
  - Feb 22: All-hands live

Rehearsal checklist (notes to self):
  - Confirm demo infra endpoints are pointing to canary lanes (miguel)
  - Pre-record customer clip and check A/V playback (asha)
  - One-pager for managers with 3 talking points and 2 canned answers for common Qs (noah)
  - Prepare fallback storyline if availability drops (lena)

Slide guidance (short):
  - Keep text light, metrics first (use redwood metric palette), no more than 3 numbers per slide
  - One slide per OKR with clear owner, measurement cadence, and open dependencies
  - Reliability slide: include short incident-response flow and escalation path (names + pager rotations)

Unresolved questions / TODOs:
  - [ ] Finalize KR baselines for cost metric (analytics + billing owner) — due Feb 18
  - [ ] Confirm reserved surge capacity pricing with infra finance — due Feb 17
  - [ ] Decide whether to run a short internal A/B on cached vs non-cached responses before public commitment — due Feb 21
  - [ ] Gather two short customer quotes for spotlight — due Feb 15 (if missed, fallback to partner case study)

Appendix: Quick audience prep snippets (copy-paste for managers):
  - "This quarter, our North Star is steady inference at scale. We will prioritize fewer outages, lower per-token cost on core workloads, and make it easier for product teams to get predictable latency. Your role: surface regressions early, flag customer-impacting tests, and help us prioritize canary windows."

Notes-to-self (raw, informal):
  - Keep the CEO ask small and tangible — execs hate shopping lists.
  - Use two demo types: one visual (dashboard) and one quick end-user story.
  - Avoid deep technical minutiae in the main stage; plan a 30m follow-up deep-dive for eng orgs.

Contact / owners: 
  - Document owner: Evelyn Chen (product-ops)
  - Narrative & slides: Noah Brooks + Asha Patel
  - Reliability + infra asks: Miguel Torres
  - Comms manager: Lena Fischer

Version notes: v0-1 — early draft. This will be split into slide deck + one-pager for managers after signoff.
